messages.author: 84db03807b3d3288
messages.subject: `strapply` unexpected results
parts:
Apologies, new to google groups and can't figure out how to do code formatting. Consider:

pattern <- "<tr><td.*?>(.*?)</td><td.*?</td><td.*?\\b(1-[2-9][0-9]{2}-[2-9][0-9]{2}-[0-9]{4})\\b"
txt <- '<tr><td>FiOS Internet and TV</td><td width=250px></td><td width="250px">1-888-881-8161</td>'

> strapply(txt, pattern, simplify=rbind)
NULL
> strapply(txt, pattern, simplify=rbind, engine="R")
[,1]
[1,] "FiOS Internet and TV"

vs. expected:

[,1] [,2]
[1,] "FiOS Internet and TV" "1-888-881-8161"

Am I doing something wrong here?

messages.author: 17e30776ec2a7fb1
messages.subject: Re: `strapply` unexpected results
parts:
tcl uses [[:<:]] and [[:>:]] for beginning and end word boundaries (rather than \b) so use

pattern <- "<tr><td.*?>(.*?)</td><td.*?</td><td.*?[[:<:]](1-[2-9][0-9]{2}-[2-9][0-9]{2}-[0-9]{4})[[:>:]]"

See this page for tcl 8.5 regular expressions
https://www.tcl.tk/man/tcl8.5/TclCmd/re_syntax.htm

parts:
Sorry if you get this twice but I don't see the first reply showing up.

Note from ?strapply that the default for the replacement= argument is 
   FUN = function(x, ...) x
Its not c since we already can get a default of c by using strapplyc.
